content.short: Clarnium is a gaming-focused launchpad and DeFi hub on TON for SocialFi and GameFi projects.
content.description: Clarnium is an AI-powered launchpad and DeFi hub specifically tailored for the gaming and SocialFi sectors within the TON ecosystem. It provides a dedicated platform for launching, trading, and promoting gaming tokens and NFTs, alongside a comprehensive suite of infrastructure tools like Clarnium Pay. Clarnium fosters a vibrant community through its social-driven mini-apps, where users can participate in PvP games and earn rewards. It is a vital incubator for the next generation of Web3 games, helping them scale and reach a global audience of gamers.
content.meta: Launch and trade GameFi projects on Clarnium. The ultimate TON gaming hub on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
